articles.summary: ( NASDAQ: ALGT ) today added two new year-round nonstop routes from Flint Bishop International Airport (FNT) to Orlando International Airport (MCO) and Southwest Florida International Airport (RSW), with limited time one-way fares as low as $69*. Due to popular demand, the airline is also adding flights to two existing routes from FNT to Sarasota Bradenton International Airport (SRQ) and St. Pete-Clearwater International Airport (PIE), expanding its network with additional affordable travel options. Launching in late winter 2027, the new routes will offer convenient nonstop service between these cities while strengthening Allegiant's presence in popular leisure destinations. The airline is known for connecting small to mid-size cities to larger markets. As more people seek value-driven travel options, Allegiant remains dedicated to making dream vacations possible with budget-friendly fares and excellent customer service. "We're pleased to expand service between Michigan and Florida
articles.title: Allegiant Announces Two New Nonstop Routes Connecting Flint-Area to Premier Florida Destinations
